mapper.select: SELECT mst.app_seq , mst.ids_seq , mst.occur_country_code , fn_get_ctry_nm(mst.occur_country_code, 'C', 'KO') as occur_country_name , mst.occur_no , mst.family_no_en , mst.is_ids_submitted , mst.create_user , mst.create_at , mst.update_user , mst.update_at , mst.del_yn , mst.note , vtdp."occurDate" , vtdp."idsPubDate" , vtdp."idsReceiptDate" , vtdp."idsSendDate" , vtdp."idsDeadline" , vtdp."idsSubmitDate" , vpp."idsSubmitMng" , vpp."idsSubmitMng_NM" FROM utb_app_ids mst LEFT JOIN v_total_duedate_pivot vtdp ON mst.ids_seq = vtdp.tbl_seq LEFT JOIN v_participant_pivot vpp ON mst.ids_seq = vpp.tbl_seq WHERE mst.office_seq = #{officeSeq} AND mst.app_seq = #{appSeq} AND mst.ids_seq = #{idsSeq} AND mst.del_yn = 'N'

SELECT mst.app_seq , mst.ids_seq , mst.occur_country_code , fn_get_ctry_nm(mst.occur_country_code, 'C', 'KO') as occur_country_name , mst.occur_no , mst.family_no_en , mst.is_ids_submitted , mst.create_user , mst.create_at , mst.update_user , mst.update_at , mst.del_yn , mst.note , vtdp."occurDate" , vtdp."idsPubDate" , vtdp."idsReceiptDate" , vtdp."idsSendDate" , vtdp."idsDeadline" , vtdp."idsSubmitDate" , vpp."idsSubmitMng" , vpp."idsSubmitMng_NM" FROM utb_app_ids mst LEFT JOIN v_total_duedate_pivot vtdp ON mst.ids_seq = vtdp.tbl_seq LEFT JOIN v_participant_pivot vpp ON mst.ids_seq = vpp.tbl_seq WHERE mst.office_seq = #{officeSeq} AND mst.app_seq = #{appSeq} AND mst.del_yn = 'N' ORDER BY mst.create_at ASC
